# Product Review Classification

Predict review sentiment or predefined labels from synthetic text reviews.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Text processing
- [ ] N-grams
- [ ] Sparse feature matrices
- [ ] Linear classifiers
- [ ] Cross-validation
- [ ] Feature inspection

Use a synthetic or properly licensed dataset. Keep training, selection, and final evaluation separate. Document setup, package versions, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.

Copy the course dataset `assets/data/product-reviews-synthetic.csv` into this project's `data/` directory as described in README. This is synthetic teaching data; do not interpret it as real people or transactions.

dataset_note: Where provided, use only for educational practice. Data files are deterministic synthetic examples and contain no real people. Copy into the starter project before running it.
